qa_pairs.question: What is the section number and title for this wiring diagram?
What fuse is shown in the power distribution box for the cruise control system?
What component receives the speed output signal from the speedometer?
qa_pairs.answer: The cruise control unit receives the speed output signal through connector C7

qa_pairs.question: What happens to the ground when the clutch switch is opened according to the diagram notes?
qa_pairs.answer: When clutch switch is opened, ground is mechanically removed

qa_pairs.question: What type of speedometer is shown in the instrument cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: SOLID STATE speedometer with printed circuit
